ai.description: This slender snake reaches 40–50 cm. It is dark brown or blackish with a pale, yellowish-white belly. Distinctive features include a rounded snout and smooth, iridescent dorsal scales.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Stoliczkia khasiensis* is best distinguished by its lack of a loreal scale, combined with a single internasal scale that sits between the prefrontals.
ai.habitat: The Khasi Earth Snake inhabits the humid, evergreen forests of the Khasi Hills in Northeast India, typically found at elevations between 1,000 and 1,500 meters.
ai.behavior: The Khasi Earth Snake is primarily nocturnal, emerging at night to forage for earthworms and soft-bodied invertebrates within the leaf litter of its forest habitat.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Stoliczkia khasiensis* is oviparous, laying small clutches of eggs. Breeding typically occurs during the monsoon season, though specific clutch sizes remain poorly documented.
ai.distributionRemarks: *Stoliczkia khasiensis* is endemic to the high-elevation forests of the Khasi Hills in Meghalaya, India, typically occurring at altitudes above 1,000 meters.
